name: Bill Foster
stance: Congress's only PhD physicist: leads bipartisan AI-chip export-security legislation to keep advanced compute out of adversary hands, and presses oversight of agentic AI in the financial system.

statements.text: Introduced the bipartisan Chip Security Act with Reps. Huizenga, Moolenaar and Krishnamoorthi, requiring location verification on advanced AI chips before export and diversion reporting to stop smuggling to China.
With advanced AI chips being smuggled into China and posing a national security risk, Congress must act
we have the technical tools to prevent powerful AI technology from getting into the wrong hands
With Rep. Sherman, led a letter pressing the SEC on oversight and investor protections for autonomous 'agentic AI' trading by retail brokerage platforms.

review.note: added October 2026 from foster.house.gov primary sources; quotes verified verbatim
